test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : CLQ :: NDK : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and third letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• # = AJS, % = MAM ⇒ AJS : CLQ :: NDK : MAM 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f27d1283de8a59e65d89958e5563c848c7c7d6ec8cb4fcbfe4953db155274c17.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = AOO, % = PAM ⇒ AOO : CLQ :: NDK : PAM 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c661fd038884ae00efa8e9489a86bb0c2182df84273474307e03069bd92d3f2.png] 

⇒Here, similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = EIT, % = QBN ⇒ EIT : CLQ :: NDK : QBN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5b4400a78c39ba97f7fa55d9d32de44cf89169d58146e735d757ed811959bb3.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = DIS, % = PBN ⇒ DIS : CLQ :: NDK : PBN​ 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cfc48663d58c54eec5f3c72458ec1e1be895212dacbeb4e7d7d2c64919656a2.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".
